messages:
maria: Can we add an interactive cost "what-if" panel to the rollout flow? Goal: preview token burn, cache delta, and per-model unit cost when changing routing/quantization/batching before we cut a canary.

kevin: +1. Has to include cache hit delta vs baseline. Otherwise engineers will be surprised by savings that never materialize.

sam: Also show end-to-end for multi-model chains — people route some calls to a cheap embedder then to an LLM. Need per-stage breakdown.

anna: UI note: keep it non-blocking — a sidebar or modal preview. Put important knobs up top: routing policy (latency vs cost), quantize toggle, batch size slider.

tejas: Suggestion for internal API: /v1/internal/cost_preview that accepts a small workload sample + overrides. Example prototype call: 

```
POST /v1/internal/cost_preview
{
  "sample_id": "recent-1k-requests",
  "overrides": {
    "route_policy": "cost_first",
    "model_overrides": {"gptx-4-8k": {"quantize": "int8"}},
    "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 2048}
  }
}
```

Response should return token_count, cache_hits_delta, per_model_unit_cost, and an uncertainty/confidence score.

kevin: Few accounting pitfalls: 1) prefetch/pipelined cache credits, 2) shared KV cache that is amortized across tenants, 3) snapshot vs steady-state cache hit differences. Need clear caveats in the UI.

maria: Good call. Let's surface assumptions (sample window, cache warmup model). Ideally show both optimistic and conservative estimates.

anna: UX asks: 1) let users toggle between absolute $ and % change, 2) show estimated latency tradeoffs inline, 3) allow saving a preview to the rollout draft.

sam: Implementation note: backend should accept either a sample_id or a synthetic distribution (percentiles). For reproducibility we should persist the sample used with the rollout.

tejas: On double-counting cache savings — proposal: compute savings with two models: (A) per-request marginal (assume cache independent), (B) systemic steady-state (simulate warmup). Present both.

kevin: +1 to both numbers. Also add a small line item for "est. model-switch fallback cost" when routing fails and we fallback to larger SKU.

maria: Ops question: will this be permitted for private deployments? We cannot upload customer samples. Maybe allow local sample ingestion in the Private console and run preview in customer-controlled infra.

tejas: yes — API should support a mode where sample is an opaque blob uploaded to the private controller and calculation runs there.

deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/cost-preview-proto -> staging :white_check_mark: (FYI)

anna: Risks: make sure the preview doesn't itself incur large model cost on every UI open — cache previews, rate-limit, and reuse recent previews.

sam: I'll sketch an implementation doc and a small db table to store previews + sample metadata. Will post PR with proto API and a mock UI screenshot.

maria: Awesome — thanks. If we can get a quick prototype by EOW we can demo in next eng sync. :rocket:
